context: A matching approved plan authorizes execution through repository-permitted delivery without another release gate or a workflow binary.

checklist.name: Continues within existing authority
checklist.description: Proceeds with implementation without asking the user to reconfirm the plan, authorize continuation, or install slopmachine

checklist.name: Completes the actual scope
checklist.description: Includes the JSON flag and its output contract docs in dependency order, existing integration proof, and the requested slopguard review

checklist.name: Carries delivery to the endpoint
checklist.description: Includes PR delivery and babysitting required CI/review through squash merge, with actual forge confirmation before reporting merged; does not stop at a commit or open PR

checklist.name: Uses existing workflow owners
checklist.description: Routes review, PR delivery, and babysitting to slopguard, slopcourier, and slopnanny without inventing a database, state protocol, or replacement CLI

checklist.name: Evidence remains truthful
checklist.description: Presents proposed actions, not fabricated implementation, passing checks, review, PR, or merge results
